fields.label: TURN/STUN Server Configuration
fields.description: Configure your TURN/STUN server for WebRTC NAT traversal. Run install_scripts/install_coturn.sh to auto-configure.

fields.label: TURN Server
fields.description: Hostname or IP address of your TURN/STUN server (e.g., stun.example.com or 192.168.1.100)

fields.label: TURN Secret
fields.description: Shared secret for TURN authentication (auto-generated during Coturn installation)

fields.label: STUN Port
fields.description: Port for STUN server (default: 3478)

fields.label: TURN Port
fields.description: Port for TURN server (default: 3478)

fields.label: TURNS Port (TLS)
fields.description: Port for TURN over TLS (default: 5349)

fields.label: Test TURN Connection
fields.description: Click to test if your TURN/STUN server is properly configured

fields.label: Connection Status
fields.options: Click "Test TURN Connection" to check server status

fields.label: Save Coturn Credentials
fields.description: After installing Coturn, use this to save the credentials to Frappe

fields.label: Info
fields.options:
ℹ️ How to use:
After running install_scripts/install_coturn.sh, the installer will show your TURN server address and secret. Enter them in the fields above, then click Save Credentials to apply.

fields.label: Save Credentials
fields.description: Save the TURN server settings entered above

fields.label: Call Features
fields.description: Enable or disable specific calling features for all users

fields.label: Enable Audio Calls
fields.description: Allow users to make voice calls

fields.label: Enable Video Calls
fields.description: Allow users to make video calls (requires camera permissions)

fields.label: Enable Screen Sharing
fields.description: Allow users to share their screen during calls

fields.label: Max Group Call Participants
fields.description: Maximum number of participants allowed in a group call (default: 5, max recommended: 8)

fields.label: Max Call Duration (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum duration for calls in seconds (0 = unlimited). Example: 3600 for 1 hour

fields.label: Enable Call History
fields.description: Store call history and statistics in the database

fields.label: Cleanup Old Calls (days)
fields.description: Automatically delete call history older than this many days (0 = never delete)

fields.label: Enable Call Recording
fields.description: Allow users to record calls locally (audio/video). Recordings are saved as WebM files.

fields.label: Enable Call Transfer
fields.description: Allow users to transfer active calls to other users (blind and attended transfer)

fields.label: Cleanup Old Recordings (days)
fields.description: Automatically delete call recordings older than this many days (0 = never delete)

fields.label: Custom Ringtone Path
fields.description: Path to custom ringtone MP3 file (e.g., /assets/f_icecore/sounds/ringtone.mp3)

fields.label: Custom Calling Tone Path
fields.description: Path to custom calling tone MP3 file (e.g., /assets/f_icecore/sounds/calling.mp3)

fields.label: Enable Debug Logs
fields.description: Enable verbose logging for troubleshooting (logs to browser console)

fields.label: Auto-Answer Calls (Testing Only)
fields.description: Automatically accept incoming calls (for testing purposes only)
